messages:
Ana (PM): quick experiment idea — recruit 3 enterprise design partners using a 2-tier NDA model (light / full). target: onboard within 3 weeks, 6-week integration feedback loop. propose $5k credits + priority support. thoughts?
Kevin S: sounds actionable. i like the 2-tier idea — light NDA for early exploration reduces friction. can we scope which customers qualify for light vs full?
Ana (PM): yes — proposed rule: light NDA for SMB/mid-market with no PII in tests; full NDA for any customer planning on production data or SOC2 reqs. open to suggestions.
Priya R: from CS perspective, light NDA will speed recruitment but expect more churn. suggest a 30-min pre-screen call to set expectations & capture success metrics.
Laura (Customer Success): +1 on the pre-screen. also recommend an onboarding checklist: integration owner, test dataset (anonymized), success criteria, and weekly check-ins for first 4 weeks.
Jordan - Eng: can we commit a small eng rota for onboarding? estimate ~8-12 engineer-hours per partner across first 2 weeks. also will need feature-flagging to toggle dedicated routing and logs.
Ana (PM): Jordan — noted. i'd propose "onboard mini-sprint" template: 2 eng hrs/week + 1 CSM hr/week for 4 weeks. if partner wants deeper work, escalate to dedicated eng hours.
Kevin S: experiment success metrics: recruitment velocity (time-to-sign), activation rate (first successful end-to-end call), retention at 6 weeks, and qualitative integration score from CS.
Priya R: can we add cost-to-serve estimate per partner — to decide if credits are enough or we need a contracted pilot?
Ana (PM): yes — finance will estimate. initial back-of-envelope: $3-6k credits covers typical eval; higher usage moves to contract.
devrel-bot: created intake form for DP NDA experiment: https://forms.redwood.com/dp-nda-experiment (auto-generated draft).
Laura (Customer Success): i'll triage invites after form responses. recommend we include a checkbox for 'willing to participate in case study'.
Ana (PM): good call. also need a minimal legal checklist for light NDA: one-way confidentiality on product and feedback, 30-day data retention max, no required bulk data sharing. Priya / legal to sign off?
Priya R: i'll loop in legal, but that checklist seems reasonable as a starting point.
Jordan - Eng: tech note: prefer to require anonymized test datasets for light NDA partners and ephemeral API keys that expire after 30 days. adds low overhead.
Kevin S: timeline — announce to targeted accounts next Tue, run recruitment for 2 weeks, onboard first 3 by end of month, run 6-week loop. anyone blocked?
Laura (Customer Success): none from my side. i'll prep the onboarding checklist doc and share a draft by tomorrow.
Ana (PM): awesome — i'll draft the pilot one-pager (scope, incentives, metrics) & send to this thread. thanks team :thumbsup:
